_comment_logos: Logo files live in images/clients/ named after the slug. Any extension works; the build finds whichever is there. A client with no logo renders as a text tile.
_comment_blurb: TODO: 'blurb' is what Chrisentia actually does with that client, in one sentence. Left empty deliberately rather than invented. A card with no blurb renders as logo and sector only, so the section works now and improves as each line is confirmed.
_comment_background: Optional. A transparent or dark image in images/clients/bg/<slug>.png gives that card an image backdrop. Cards without one use a plain tint. Mixing a few image cards among plain ones reads better than all of them having images.
_comment_relationship: Shown under the name. Use Client or Partner accurately, not interchangeably.
